# Retired parent-run producer v1 independent review

Summary: one confirmed historical-provenance defect; no additional material ownership/authority defect found in this bounded static read. The draft does not yet provide a complete cold worker capability.

Reviewed exact artifact `/private/tmp/kegari-retired-parent-run-producer-draft-v1`: FILES.json 9cd5543e7f4def99126ad5088a303b7d62697933a5a3f11b747a242ed932e501; changes.patch f1857739e15e45f07cf87f4aff5ee7d8a7a34f9aac5aa83274ea77aab18b9012. All twelve draft hashes and eight base hashes were checked, and all twelve remained unchanged after review. No Cargo, native/process probes, provider requests, or repository edits occurred.

## Confirmed finding

`delivery_parent_run_origin.rs::ParentAssignmentOrigin::capture` reads selected delta patch chunks and integrated output chunks, then retains newly computed per-file hashes without checking those same bytes against the original signed `DeltaManifest.patch_digest` or `RetainedOutput.original.{digest,bytes}`. A chunk altered after the earlier vector/review verification but before this capture can therefore be signed as original history. Later `ParentOriginRecord::validate_history` only compares the newly retained hashes, perpetuating the substitution. Existing `DeliveryCoordinator::retained_delta` and `reverify_integrated_record` perform the omitted aggregate checks, but they are not called on the exact newly captured bytes.

Required correction: bounded ordered single-read aggregate verification with original digest/length and existing chunk uniqueness/count/byte bounds, followed by retaining hashes computed from those same approved bytes. A protected-file helper regression can demonstrate alteration before first capture without creating a parent/join/cold capability. Root assigned this correction separately; held v1 stays unchanged.

## Bounded no-finding evidence

- Only actual integrated/parent assignment producers create the private origin. Original assignment digest stays unchanged; prepared origin binds the actual registered contract, successful closed preparation, source leaves, context/prompt/tool/workflow manifest and exact source/acceptance/reassembly references.
- Only collect_finished after actual OwnedWorkerRun::join can create JoinedParentRetirementCandidate. It requires registered contract Arc identity. finish_trial/public completion DTOs do not manufacture that candidate. Mismatched results remain fenced and cannot be later retired via the normal local-exit loop.
- Writer additionally requires actual local_exit_confirmed, empty execution entries, actual closed model/prep receipts, unchanged original budget/scope/owner and observation, retained actual completion pointer, full ordered session journal with after-hook closure, and each actual qualified check’s exact finished journal and Control result.
- Process history remains data only, includes exact owner/work/scope and guard identity, and never promotes ProcessState::GroupExited into cold descendant-exit authority. Registry emptiness alone does not mint join evidence.
- Model/prep receipt and journal reads occur through read-only receipt storage inside Control serialization; no Control state-mutex reentry or remote I/O was found in those callbacks. RuntimeState guards are dropped before entering Control. Actual parent source validation used here is filesystem/retained-history validation, not a new remote dispatch.
- Own missing seal is distinguished from missing referenced files before first write; known same-process seal digest blocks missing/replaced reminting. Existing same seal is replay/readback. Persistence errors preserve candidate ownership and per-operation diagnostics.
- The sole encoded `retained_receipt_scan_without_emitted_index` variant accurately admits the missing dispatch-time emitted-effect index. The authenticated reader is private and consumed only by writer revalidation, with no current cold dispatch factory. The known missing-index prerequisite is not a newly discovered defect or a qualification claim.

## Nonblocking observation and limits

Already-sealed candidates are fully revalidated/rehashed on every collection and twice in a local-exit pass. This creates growing synchronous history I/O under Control; Git confirmed no sealed fast path is intended yet. No observed latency or correctness failure is claimed. Optimize only with preserved missing/replaced-reference detection if measured.

The four authored tests are raw data/protected-I/O tests, not actual joined parent positive coverage. This review does not typecheck APIs, qualify native execution or prove a complete emitted-effect index. A future cold verifier must separately authenticate that missing closure and perform fresh source/provider/process reconciliation without deserializing RunCompletion.

## Deadline finding

`GitOperationState::run` now starts its command clock before gate acquisition and
journal/guard preparation (`git.rs:3200`). However, the `start` closure calls only
`self.current`, whose deadline is the longer whole-operation deadline. It does
not check `command_deadline` before `OwnedGroup::spawn_std`.

Consequently, an actual start gate waiting on Control or slow guard preparation
can consume the command timeout, yet a local Git command can still spawn and
perform effects before the new command deadline is noticed after identity
capture. This does not mint another owner or pretend cleanup occurred; it fails
to enforce the moved finite command bound at its execution boundary. The current
one-nanosecond test deliberately exercises such an already-expired spawn.

Required narrow fix: use the same local command-deadline/current predicate at
entry/start and immediately before actual spawn, without another Control call or
new authority. Change the already-expired test to assert no spawn/probe/input, and
exercise post-spawn expiry separately through a bounded controlled delay in the
one injected missing-identity snapshot. All actual cleanup/unknown holds must
remain unchanged. The concern and correction were sent to root and Config before
this record.
